Section 135C.1, Code 2025, is amended by adding 5 the following new subsection: 6 NEW SUBSECTION . 16A. “Pediatric palliative care patient” 7 means an individual described by all of the following: 8 a. The individual is under twenty-one years of age. 9 b. The individual has been diagnosed with a chronic, 10 complex, life-threatening illness that is expected to shorten 11 the individual’s life expectancy. 12 c. A facility 22 within the special classification established pursuant to 23 this subsection shall be exempt from section 10A.713. The 24 department shall adopt rules pursuant to chapter 17A which 25 shall include but not be limited to all of the following: 26 a.
